{{short description|Italian mathematician}}
[[File:Politi_-_Questio_de_modalibus_-_4621816.tif|thumb|''Questio de modalibus'', title page]]

'''Bassano Politi''' was a [[16th century|16th-century]] [[Italy|Italian]] [[mathematician]].

He published ''Questio de modalibus'', a book where he collected several [[Middle Ages|medieval]] [[Treatise|treatises]] by [[Thomas Bradwardine]], [[Nicole Oresme]], [[Biagio Pelacani]], and [[Giovanni de Casali]].<ref>{{cite book|author=[[William Beloe]]|title=Anecdotes of Literature and Scarce Books|volume=5|publisher=F. C. & J. Rivington|year=1811|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=jXoMAAAAYAAJ&pg=PT322|pages=322–323}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|author=Stillman Drake|title=Essays on Galileo and the History and Philosophy of Science|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=dKEqrYdQ0I0C&pg=PA257|year=1999|publisher=University of Toronto Press|isbn=978-0-8020-8165-0|page=257}}</ref>
